title: The Kindly Room
author: Quentin Amberdale
blurb: Ada Voss, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
